title: The tragedy of the commons
src: Garrett Hardin, 1968; Elinor Ostrom, Governing the Commons, 1990
idea: When everyone shares a resource and each takes a bit more for themselves, the shared resource collapses. Ostrom showed that groups can prevent it with clear rules.
apply: For any shared resource, make use visible, name an owner, and agree on simple rules before it is depleted.
remind: Shared things need owners and rules.
who: Marta's office, where the shared fridge keeps filling with forgotten food.

scenes.nar: Thirty people share one office fridge. Everyone adds food, few remove it, and nobody owns it.
Within weeks it overflows. No room for lunches, a bad smell, and everyone blaming everyone. Each person's small contribution adds up to a mess.

items.x: Friday clean out, agreed by all

scenes.nar: Elinor Ostrom showed that groups can manage shared things with clear rules. Marta rotates an owner each week, asks for dates on labels, and sets a Friday clean out.

items.x: Rules take two minutes a week

scenes.nar: A month later there is space for every lunch, and no more blame. The rules take about two minutes a week.
